bihar_raw_news.content: Government Policies 1 min read Bihar plans additional regional language for Classes 1-5 in govt schools Maithili, Bhojpuri, Bajjika, Magahi or Angika may be offered under NEP; state also plans Plus-II pathway for Madhyama pass-outs through Sanskrit Education Board Adwitiya Deb TOI.in Published On Oct 7, 2026 at 07:05 PM IST Select ETEducation as Preferred Choice on Google Copy Link Share on WhatsApp Share on Linkedin Share on X Share on Telegram Share on Facebook Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary Patna: The state education department is working to introduce one additional regional language — Maithili, Bhojpuri, Bajjika, Magahi or Angika — for students of classes I to V in govt schools, education minister Mithilesh Tiwari said on Tuesday. The move is being planned under the National Education Policy , with the department also focusing on skill-based and employment-oriented education, Tiwari said while reviewing its functioning at Vikas Bhawan. The meeting discussed allowing students who pass the Madhyama examination to pursue Plus-II studies through the Bihar Sanskrit Education Board. Advt Necessary amendments to the relevant Act will be made, officials said. Around 24,000 students passed the examination last year. bihar_raw_news.title: SECI floats tender for 60 MW solar project in Bihar - Renewable Watch
bihar_raw_news.content: The Solar Energy Corporation of India Limited (SECI) has issued a tender for the design, engineering, supply, construction, erection, testing, commissioning and operation and maintenance (O&M) of a 60 MWac inter-state transmission system-connected ground-mounted solar photovoltaic (PV) power plant at Gaya, Bihar. The tender will follow a single-stage, two-envelope bidding procedure. The deadline for online bid submission is November 12, 2026. According to the tender guidelines, the scope of work includes the complete design, engineering, supply, construction, erection, testing and commissioning of the power plant. The selected bidder will also be responsible for comprehensive O&M of the plant for five years following successful commissioning and performance demonstration, including the supply and storage of mandatory spare parts and consumables and repair or replacement of defective equipment. The contract will be awarded in two parts, comprising the supply and services component and a separate O&M component. The tender mandates the use of domestically manufactured solar PV cells and modules listed in the Approved List of Models and Manufacturers. Moreover, the bidders are required to submit an earnest money deposit of Rs 64.36 million and a tender processing fee of Rs 25,000 plus GST. According to the financial eligibility criteria, bidders should have a minimum average annual turnover of Rs 965.4 million during the last three financial years. The net worth for the last financial year should be positive, while the minimum working capital requirement is Rs 536.3 million. In case of inadequate working capital, the bidder can alternatively supplement the requirement with a bank letter confirming availability of a credit line of at least Rs 536.3 million, provided by a bank having a net worth of not less than Rs 5 billion. solar EPC Solar PV ground-mounted solar domestic solar manufacturing Bihar Energy solar power SECI Renewable Energy

bihar_raw_news.content: Bihar teen reaches Level 22,222 in Candy Crush, enters International Book of Records Shubham Kumar has been recognised under the category "Highest Level Achieved in Candy Crush Saga (Teenager)". Advertisement Remove Ad By CNBCTV18.com October 7, 2026, 5:33:12 PM IST (Published) A 19-year-old from Bihar has achieved something unusual. He has reached Level 22,222 in the popular mobile game Candy Crush Saga. His achievement has now been recognised by the International Book of Records. Shubham Kumar, from Dighwara in Bihar, has been recognised under the category "Highest Level Achieved in Candy Crush Saga (Teenager)". According to the record listing, he reached the milestone on July 5, 2026. He was 19 years, 8 months and 25 days old at the time. Candy Crush Saga is a popular puzzle game where players match candies of the same colour to complete different tasks, such as clearing certain candies, removing obstacles or reaching a target score. As players move through the game, the challenges change and become more difficult. Kumar’s achievement has now been formally recorded by the International Book of Records. His record is specifically listed in the teenager category. It also does not say how many hours he spent playing the game or how long it took him to reach Level 22,222. It also does not explain how he managed his studies along with his progress in the game. ETRajasthan Updated On Oct 7, 2026 at 12:42 PM IST Rajasthan’s rail map is set for another round of expansion after the Union rail ministry cleared three new long-distance services that will pass through several districts in the state. According to reporting carried by an unidentified publisher, the approvals followed a request from Chief Minister Bhajan Lal Sharma and were signed off by Railways Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw . The decision matters less for the number of trains than for the corridors they open up. Two of the services will link Rajasthan with western coastal and northern pilgrimage centres, while the third will strengthen a route connecting the state to eastern India. For passengers, that means more direct options across a network where long-distance demand often outstrips seat availability. Which routes have been cleared The first service is the Bhuj-Barauni Amrit Bharat Express , which will run through Kota , Sawai Madhopur , Gangapur City and Bharatpur on its way across the network. The second is the Haridwar-Okha Express , which has been approved to operate via Alwar , Jaipur , Ajmer and Abu Road . The third, the Haridwar-Veraval Express , will follow the same Rajasthan stretch through Alwar, Jaipur, Ajmer and Abu Road. All three services have been approved for operation on the specified routes, giving Rajasthan a larger share in trains that connect distant parts of the country. The additions also underline the state’s strategic position in the north-western rail grid, where major junctions such as Jaipur, Ajmer and Kota serve as transfer points for traffic moving between western, northern and eastern India. Why the approval matters for Rajasthan For Rajasthan, new long-distance trains are not just about convenience. They are also about access, mobility and the ability of smaller cities to stay linked to major economic and religious destinations. bihar_raw_news.title: The 6-lane Varanasi–Kolkata via Hazaribagh Expressway project kick -starts in Jharkhand
bihar_raw_news.content: * Representative picture showing a part of the multi-state 6-lane Varanasi–Kolkata via Hazaribagh Expressway connecting Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal. The construction work has begun for a part of the multi-state 6-lane Varanasi–Kolkata via Hazaribagh Expressway connecting Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Jharkhand, and West Bengal. As it is, the Hazaribagh Stretch covers approximately 48 km across 5 blocks (Sadar, Churchu, Katkamdag, Barkagaon, and Dadi) and 26 villages. The district administration has completed land acquisition after disbursing compensation of about ₹59 crore. “Construction is progressing under the Hazaribagh Project Implementation Unit”, said a Project Unit officer preferring anonymity. Also, Expressway Project Director Manoj Kumar Pandey has said, “Land acquisition in Hazaribag is complete. Construction is under way in Katkamdag. Efforts are being made to complete the work within the deadline.” Land acquisition for an interchange linking Hazaribag district to the proposed six-lane Varanasi-Kolkata Greenfield Expressway was completed at Phataha in Katkamdag block of Hazaribag district, where construction has begun on site under Bharatmala Pariyojana. Nearly 733 acres have been acquired for the interchange, which will provide expressway access to Hazaribag and the neighbouring districts of Chatra, Koderma, and Ramgarh. It would also improve connectivity to Barkagaon and the coal belt, creating a faster route to Varanasi, Bihar, and West Bengal, according to a report. The district administration had acquired around 733 acres in 26 villages for the project. The Land Acquisition Office has disbursed nearly Rs 59 crore to landowners as compensation, an official said. About 48 km of the expressway will pass through Hazaribag district. It will enter through Itkhori near Bedgi village in Chatra, cross Katkamsandi, and continue towards Ramgarh via Chainpur in Mandu. bihar_raw_news.title: Samrat Choudhary warns of action within 24 hours against those targeting women in Bihar
bihar_raw_news.content: (Photo: Samrat Choudhary's X account) India 6th October 2026 Patna, October 6 (IANS) Bihar Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary on Tuesday visited Sasaram in Rohtas district and addressed a 'Yuva Samvad' programme at Jamuhar, where he spoke about women's safety, law and order and the development of the state. Addressing the gathering, Choudhary said that given the prevailing security environment in the state, anyone who dares to harm or molest women will face action within 24 hours. He said he was making this commitment to the women of Bihar in his capacity as the state's leader. Referring to five videos of incidents that had surfaced from different parts of Bihar, Chief Minister Choudhary said immediate action had been taken in the cases. He also added that millions of women are now stepping out of their homes to work, attributing the change to the governance of the NDA. Targeting the Opposition, the Chief Minister said that some people view political power as an opportunity for personal gain, whereas the NDA and Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) consider power a means to serve the people. Praising Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Chief Minister Choudhary said that despite being in power for 25 consecutive years, PM Modi had remained committed to serving the public and continued to uphold that approach. He contrasted the present situation in Bihar with the period before 2005, recalling that areas of Rohtas and Kaimur had once been affected by the activities of dacoits and that people were fearful of travelling from Kaimur towards Ara. He said the situation had changed significantly and reiterated that anyone who harms a woman in Bihar would face arrest within 24 hours. The event was attended by MP BD Singh, former MP Gopal Narayan Singh, MLA Trivikram Narayan Singh and BJP leader Bhikhubhai Dalsania. During his Rohtas visit, CM Choudhary inaugurated the Sasaram Bypass and inspected the Beda Flyover. The 9.2-km Beda-Mokar bypass is a part of the Bihar government's infrastructure push in the district. He also inspected a pond renovated under the 'Kayakalp Abhiyan' and reviewed ongoing development works in the area. Earlier, CM Choudhary addressed a gathering after inaugurating an astronomy laboratory at the PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya in Karup Panchayat under Shivsagar block. He also participated in the 'Seva Setu Abhiyan' support camp and reviewed various government schemes and development initiatives. The Chief Minister also interacted with youth at the Narayan Medical College in Sasaram as part of his outreach programme.

national_raw_news.content: The Union Cabinet has passed a resolution congratulating Prime Minister Narendra Modi for completing 25 years as the head of government. First, Mr Modi became the Chief Minister of Gujarat on 7th October 2001 and then became Prime Minister in 2014, and today he is completing 25 years as the head of government. Information and Broadcasting Minister Ashwini Vaishnaw said that Prime Minister Modi’s 25-year tenure is a testimony to the strength of Indian democracy. He said that a person from an ordinary family who dedicated himself to the service of the nation and is continuing to serve the country is a major example of the vitality, vibrancy and maturity of the democracy. Mr Vaishnaw said that Prime Minister Modi has created history that is unique in any democratic country. He said there are very few countries in the world where the people have repeatedly extended their support to a single leader. The minister said this support has been given because of his style of functioning, his right policies and his clear and good intentions. The Bharatiya Janata Party and Prime Minister Narendra Modi have always pursued public service, national service and the spirit of putting the nation first and the nation above all, with clear intentions and clear policies. The Minister highlighted ten major points of this Cabinet resolution. The first point is the expansion of the vision of development from Gujarat to the entire country. He said Prime Minister Narendra Modi introduced several changes in Gujarat through his programmes and policies, for which Mr Modi was honoured across the world. The Gujarat model was recognised and appreciated across the world and was subsequently implemented across India.

national_raw_news.title: 41 mins ago | National 39 PM Modi interacts with GSMA Board members at Seva Teerth
national_raw_news.content: Prime Minister Narendra Modi has emphasised that technology must become a tool for inclusive and sustainable development. Prime Minister Modi interacted with Global System for Mobile Communications Association (GSMA) Board members at Seva Teerth yesterday, ahead of the India Mobile Congress. The India Mobile Congress is scheduled to be held from the 7th to the 10th of this month in New Delhi. Mr Modi stressed that democratisation of technology is essential to ensure that no section of society is left behind. He emphasised the need to make technology and digital services affordable and accessible, particularly for the Global South, and highlighted the importance of taking technology to the last mile to prevent a widening digital divide. The Prime Minister highlighted the potential of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) as a transformative force, particularly for developing countries. He noted that discussions on DPI with several world leaders had demonstrated its growing global relevance and said that such platforms can serve as a springboard for countries of the Global South. Addressing the growing challenge of digital and cyber fraud, Mr Modi said, the problem requires technology-driven solutions. He suggested sustained awareness messages for users to warn people about potential fraud calls. The Prime Minister also highlighted the need for global standards and common rules for emerging technologies. On the growing threat of deepfakes and AI-generated content, he suggested exploring mechanisms to allow users to immediately identify its origin. GSMA is a global organisation unifying the mobile ecosystem, representing mobile operators and organisations across the mobile ecosystem and adjacent industries. The GSMA Board members highlighted India’s emergence as a global leader in digital and mobile connectivity. They noted the rapid expansion of 4G and 5G, the scale of digital public infrastructure and the growth of the telecom and mobile manufacturing ecosystem. They hailed India’s investment-friendly policy framework and emphasised the role of secure, resilient and trusted digital infrastructure in supporting continued digital growth. The meeting was attended by Minister of Communications, Jyotiraditya Scindia, Minister of State for Communications, Dr. Pemmasani Chandra Sekhar, GSMA board members and senior officials of the government.

national_raw_news.title: India, UK to deepen cross-border investment, explore GIFT IFSC listings under financial ...
national_raw_news.content: India, UK to deepen cross-border investment, explore GIFT IFSC listings under financial markets dialogue Toggle navigation हिंदी खबर India, UK to deepen cross-border investment, explore GIFT IFSC listings under financial markets dialogue ANI | Updated: Oct 07, 2026 18:38 IST ANI News Join our Whatsapp channel New Delhi [India], October 7 (ANI): India and the United Kingdom have agreed to explore measures to deepen cross-border investment and strengthen capital market connectivity, including through equity and bond listings via Gujarat International Finance Tec-City International Financial Services Centre (GIFT IFSC), according to a joint statement issued after the fourth India-UK Financial Markets Dialogue. The dialogue, held in London on September 29, brought together senior officials from the Ministry of Finance and HM Treasury, along with financial sector regulators from both countries. Discussions covered capital markets, insurance and pensions, asset management, sustainable finance, fintech and innovation. On capital markets, the two sides discussed opportunities to increase cross-border investment and improve Indian firms' access to international capital. They agreed to identify priority areas for future cooperation ahead of the next Economic and Financial Dialogue. India highlighted reforms undertaken by the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) to streamline global investor participation, while the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) highlighted measures that have eased overseas access to Indian sovereign and corporate debt. The two countries also agreed to continue regulatory cooperation and knowledge-sharing to support the development of GIFT IFSC as an international financial centre, with the dialogue noting its growing role in mobilising international capital into India. In insurance and pensions, both sides discussed opportunities arising from India's evolving reinsurance regulatory framework and deeper cooperation between the London Market and Indian insurers and reinsurers. They also agreed to continue work under the Insurance and Pensions Workplan established in 2023. The dialogue further recognised London's role as the leading offshore rupee trading hub and welcomed the continued internationalisation of the Indian rupee. India and the UK also agreed to maintain regulatory cooperation in asset management and sustainable finance, including on disclosures, global standards and investor confidence. On fintech, the countries exchanged views on artificial intelligence and its opportunities and risks in financial services. They also discussed risks from the criminal use of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled fraud, cybersecurity threats and operational risks. Both sides reaffirmed support for the G20 Roadmap for Enhancing Cross-Border Payments and discussed measures to reduce friction, improve transparency and strengthen interoperability between electronic payment infrastructures. The two countries said the Financial Markets Dialogue would continue to support deeper financial services links, particularly following the launch of Vision 2035 and the implementation of the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement. In a significant step towards further strengthening community participation in India’s fight against tuberculosis (TB), the Union Ministry of Health & Family Welfare, in collaboration with the Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports and the Ministry of Defence, will launch JOSH (Joint Squad for Health) Teams on October 8, 2026, at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi. In the first phase, JOSH Teams will be rolled out across 55 districts in 11 States, with the objective of strengthening youth-led community mobilisation and taking the message of TB Mukt Bharat to the grassroots. Union Minister for Health & Family Welfare and Chemicals & Fertilisers, Jagat Prakash Nadda, will lead the national launch of JOSH Teams in the presence of Mansukh Mandaviya, Union Minister for Labour & Employment and Youth Affairs & Sports; Sanjay Seth, Minister of State for Defence; and Rekha Gupta, Chief Minister of Delhi. The event will bring together senior leadership and stakeholders from the participating Ministries, elected representatives, Class-I Officers, MY Bharat Volunteers, NCC Cadets and other stakeholders associated with India’s TB elimination efforts. The programme will feature an achievement video highlighting key milestones of the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan, followed by the formal launch of JOSH Teams. New Information, Education and Communication (IEC) materials for the TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan will also be launched. The event will further witness the launch of Khushi Avatar, an AI-powered chatbot, aimed at strengthening public awareness, community engagement and participation in the national effort towards TB elimination. JOSH Teams have been envisaged as a structured mechanism to translate the energy and reach of India’s youth into organised community action for TB elimination. The teams will bring together Class-I Officers, MY Bharat Volunteers and NCC Cadets, combining administrative leadership with the extensive youth networks and community outreach capabilities of MY Bharat and NCC. In the first phase, the initiative will focus on strengthening engagement at the Block/Ward and community levels, taking the TB Mukt Bharat message beyond health facilities and closer to people and communities where they live, work and interact. Through community outreach and engagement, JOSH Teams will support the dissemination of key messages on TB symptoms, prevention, timely diagnosis and completion of treatment.
